reason: Conversation contains firmware-specific behavior regarding baseband recovery after a power outage and a workaround for older units.

knowledge.summary: Base stations running firmware version 2.6 and later automatically recover baseband after a power outage, eliminating the need for cold restarts.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto

knowledge.summary: Base stations on firmware below 2.6 still require a cold restart to recover baseband after a power outage.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
